title: Await
description:
[`await`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Operators/await) _awaits_ a `Promise`'s resolve. Once the promise resolves it retrns the resolved value. It's just a more coherent `.then()`.

## Example:
---

### .then version
```ts
promise.then((promised) => {
  console.log(promised);
};
```
### await version
```ts
const promised = await promise;
console.log(promised);
```

---
> I Recommend using `await` over `.then()` (when possible) because it allows cleaner line by line code.

## Handling Rejects
---
`await` just throws errors on rejects. _Try Catch anybody?_
